wageData.title: $18 an Hour is How Much a Year? ($37,440 Salary in 2026)
wageData.metaDescription: $18 an hour is $37,440 per year before taxes, or $3,120/mo and $1,440 biweekly for a 40-hour work week. See exact take-home pay after 2026 taxes.
wageData.h1: $18 an Hour is How Much a Year?
wageData.aeoDirectAnswer: Working 40 hours per week at **$18 an hour** equals an annual gross salary of **$37,440 per year** ($3,120 per month, $1,440 biweekly, or $720 per week). After standard 2026 Federal Income Tax ($2,502) and FICA ($2,864), your estimated net take-home pay is approximately **$32,074 per year** ($2,673/month) in zero-income-tax states like Texas or Florida.

faqs.q: $18 an hour is how much a year?
faqs.a: $18 an hour is $37,440 per year for a full-time employee working 40 hours per week (2,080 working hours in 52 weeks). If you take 2 weeks of unpaid vacation (2,000 hours), your annual gross earnings are $36,000.

faqs.q: How much is $18 an hour monthly?
faqs.a: At $18 per hour, your gross monthly pay is approximately $3,120 per month before taxes and deductions.
For employees paid every two weeks (26 paychecks per year), $18 an hour results in a gross biweekly paycheck of $1,440 (80 regular hours).

faqs.q: How much is $18 an hour after taxes?
faqs.a: After subtracting 2026 Federal Income Tax ($2,502) and FICA taxes ($2,864), a single filer takes home approximately $32,074 annually ($2,673/month or $1,234 biweekly) in states with no state income tax. In states like California or New York, state income tax will reduce net pay by an additional $936 to $1,123 per year.
